data_fields.name: frame_motion_distance
data_fields.donor_constant: authored distance per frame, times monster scale (soldier walk 3, 6, 2, 2, 2, 1)

data_fields.name: frame_event_index
data_fields.donor_constant: event on the third of twelve frames of the soldier attack move

data_fields.name: pain_debounce_hard_mode
data_fields.donor_constant: 5 s after a pain call on the nightmare skill

data_fields.name: pain_roll_split
data_fields.donor_constant: roll below 0.33 picks pain move 1, below 0.66 move 2, else move 3

data_fields.name: airborne_pain_velocity
data_fields.donor_constant: vertical velocity above 100 picks pain move 4

data_fields.name: half_health_variant
data_fields.donor_constant: health below max_health / 2 sets the skin variant bit

best_idea: Put a creature's attack as a frame-indexed event inside its clip table, so the server applies the hit on the exact frame the data names and the timing is data, not a timer the client guesses.
decision_why: The frame table, queued jump, hold flag and end hook are the right shape for server-owned creature clips, but the donor's pain roll and nightmare skip are gameplay choices we must make on the server with a seeded roll, and its hooks are C functions that we replace with named events read from the creature catalogue (zone data, our proposal).
acceptance: A server test runs one creature swing move on the server tick and asserts the hit is applied exactly once, on the frame the data names (frame 3 of 12 in the test data), never on a held frame, and that a second hit inside the 3 s pain debounce does not restart the pain move.
